name: Divine Decadence: Seduction and Fall from Grace
source:
What do you expect when you get back home from a hard day of work? In the case of Daemon she expected the usual, being greeted by her partner the Fallen Angel Olibanum and that's exactly what she got, except that Olibanum was naked.

[From [url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/divine-decadence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你结束一天的辛苦工作回到家时，你期望什么？就戴蒙而言，她和往常一样期待着她的伴侣堕落天使奥利巴努姆的到来，而这正是她所得到的，只不过奥利巴努姆是赤身裸体的。

[来自[url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/divine-decadence]itch.io[/url]]
